comments.text:
In bank interviews, the language is typically formal and professional. Here are some tips:

1. *English*: Most bank interviews are conducted in English, so be prepared to speak fluently and clearly.
2. *Technical terms*: Familiarize yourself with banking and finance terminology, as you may be asked to explain concepts or use industry-specific language.
3. *Clear and concise*: Communicate your thoughts and answers in a clear, concise, and structured manner.
4. *Avoid jargon*: Use simple language to explain complex concepts, avoiding technical jargon unless necessary.
5. *Professional tone*: Maintain a professional tone throughout the interview, avoiding slang, colloquialisms, or overly casual language.
6. *Be prepared*: Review common interview questions and practice your responses to feel more confident and articulate during the interview.

Some common banking terms to familiarize yourself with include:

- Assets
- Liabilities
- Equity
- ROI (Return on Investment)
- EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization)
- Risk management
- Credit analysis
- Financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement)

Remember to be confident, articulate, and professional in your language during the interview.

Q.1) Tell me about yourself?
Ans - My name is Pushan Chakraborty. I am from Khardha, North 24 parganas, Kolkata. I have completed my schooling from St. Xavier's institution. panihati, sodepore, Kolkata. Then I have completed my Graduation from Annex College of management studies. Kolkata.
During the time of my graduation I have worked in Skill Academia which is an e learning company as an administrative intern. 
Q2) What is the job role of a Relationship manager?
Work of a relationship manager include mostly sales. They have to sale variety of banking products and services. Like loans, insurance, mutual fund, fixed deposit, credit card, opening account, etc. They have to maintain strong relationship with customers and have to acquire new customers and work relating to cross sales. 
Q3) why do you want to join ICICI Bank?
Ans - ICICI Bank is the second largest bank of India and working with such a big branded, reputed company is itself is a sence of pride. It's a white collar jobs and there is respect in the society. Also I can learn about lot of things relating to financial products and services which bank sales. It will give a boost to my knowledge of sales. Not only that I can also able to manage my finance properly.
Q4) how can you stay updated with the latest financial news?
Ans - I have subscription of few current affairs YouTube channel from which I get good news of current affairs regarding financial and economic news. Example, the recent hike in sensex and there is a sudden downfall.
